detail_observations.text: Preceptor Indradi "The bow of Sendical Valion is an important artifact," Preceptor Indradi says, "but I fear something more dangerous is going on here." "I need you to track the bow down, but if it has already changed hands, it will be beyond your powers to re-acquire. Track down its location. Do not worry, someone will be following you. See Achryn Cerurn in Vescal's Exchange. He runs an inn there and hears many things. He also owes me a favor."

Winding Roads

Level 4 · Diplomacy · Leth Nurae · Thestra

Order of the Azure Flame

Objectives

Speak with Achryn Cerurn Speak with Veskal Rukeru Seek out Achryn Cerum and speak to him. Speak to whom he indicates and follow the bow's trail.

Description

Achryn Cerurn - Barkeep at the inn, loc -34216, -10954, 51663 in Veskal's Exchange (-24, 26). Veskal Rukeru - In the tower near the mailbox, loc -24555, -16158, 52336 in Veskal's Exchange (-24, 26). Lars Orson - Wandering around cleaning the Guard Tower above Lord Renton, loc -73266, -37, 49078 in Renton Keep (-26, 26).

What they say

On taking it

Preceptor Indradi
"The bow of Sendical Valion is an important artifact," Preceptor Indradi says, "but I fear something more dangerous is going on here." "I need you to track the bow down, but if it has already changed hands, it will be beyond your powers to re-acquire. Track down its location. Do not worry, someone will be following you. See Achryn Cerurn in Vescal's Exchange. He runs an inn there and hears many things. He also owes me a favor."

Recorded by wiki.silkyvenom.com.

findings.observation: Objectives name Achryn Cerurn and Veskal Rukeru; a further objective spells the first name Achryn Cerum. Details starts with Preceptor Indradi, hands in to Lars Orson, and lists both intermediaries. Preserve the spelling variant without assigning canonical NPC IDs or parley parameters.

Details location 31607, -62990, 67169 occurs alongside starter Preceptor Indradi. Description gives Achryn -34216, -10954, 51663 and Veskal -24555, -16158, 52336 in Veskal's Exchange (-24, 26), and Lars -73266, -37, 49078 in Renton Keep (-26, 26). Notes instead gives Achryn -34410, -10850, 51682, Veskal -30100, -13923, 51664, and Lars -73746, -1098, 49108. Preserve all contexts and do not select a verified spawn.

One recorded disagreement labels loc (fandom), without an alternate value attached to that label. Full article and source records preserve this unresolved collision; no canonical location is selected.

Previous The Wings of Authority reciprocates the prior cached review's Next. Next is Sweeper Agent. Series Thestran Web Quests and Chain Thestra Web Quests remain separate printed labels. Navigation does not establish enforced prerequisites.

Taking dialogue credits wiki.silkyvenom.com and spells Vescal's Exchange. Source links thetelonproject.wikidot.com. These originals were not fetched during this review; mirrored accounts do not provide independent corroboration. Notes gallery filenames and printed :4 markers do not establish card rules or parley thresholds.
Repeatable yes has no conditions. Coin reward 50 has no denomination, so copper value remains unknown.
